items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: At that time the Mills Brothers, they were very popular... these guys were great inspirations to all of us

ctx.x: How did you happen to start playing guitar at that age, and how come it was guitar that you started playing first?

Now, let me -- let me think awhile. Got to get my head together here. Oh, I know. Yeah, I can associate it now. At that time the Mills Brothers, they were very popular, and this is before John Mills died, you know, and all the kids around Chicago, we all had little quartet singing groups, because these guys were great inspirations, a great inspiration to all of us, you know?
